label: SearXNG
description: Self-hosted metasearch, pointed at your own endpoint.

errors.status: web_search {status} — try: the search backend returned an error; rephrase the query, or switch engines in Settings (General page).
errors.rateLimit: web_search 429 — try: wait 10s before retrying, or rephrase the query; the search backend is rate-limiting this client
errors.forbidden: web_search 403 — try: the search backend is blocking this client; switch engines in Settings (General page), or wait and retry later.
errors.serverError: web_search {status} — try: open the search URL in a browser; if it loads this is transient and a retry in 30s may help
errors.cannotReach: web_search: Cannot reach SearXNG server at {endpoint} — try: install and start SearXNG (https://github.com/searxng/searxng, e.g. `docker run -d -p 8080:8080 searxng/searxng`), or switch engines in Settings (General page).
errors.invalidEndpoint: web_search: invalid SearXNG endpoint "{endpoint}" — try: set a valid base URL in Settings (General page, SearXNG endpoint)
errors.endpointMustBeHttp: web_search: SearXNG endpoint must be http(s), got {protocol} — try: set a valid base URL in Settings (General page, SearXNG endpoint)
errors.noResults: web_search: 0 results but SearXNG response doesn't look like an empty results page ({chars} chars) — try: rephrase the query with simpler terms, or switch engines in Settings (General page).

settings.label: SearXNG endpoint
settings.hint: Base URL of your SearXNG instance. Defaults to http://localhost:8080.
